title: Possible duplicate charges
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. Repeated procedure codes on the same nonmissing service date with identical modifiers are candidates for duplicate review. Keep the first listed charge and provisionally dispute later matching charges. Repeated services can be legitimate; request records before concluding an error. Missing dates and differing modifiers do not establish a duplicate. These are possible errors, not proof of fraud.

title: Fictional price comparison
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. Each fictional reference is a price per unit. Compare the line total against unit price times quantity. Flag only when the billed line total is strictly greater than 1.5 times that reference total. The illustrative disputed amount is the billed total minus the reference total. Fictional references are not Medicare prices, contractual rates, patient responsibility, or evidence that a real charge is improper.

title: Fictional laboratory bundling
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. For this demo only, code 80053 includes 82947 and 82565 when on the same known service date. Flag separately billed component charges for review and provisionally dispute their full amounts. Modifiers 59, XE, XP, XS, or XU on a component indicate a distinct service and suppress this demo rule. This simplified rule is fictional and must not be used for real reimbursement decisions.

title: Visit date consistency
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. Flag a service before the stated visit start or after the stated visit end. Missing dates require clarification. A date mismatch has no assumed dollar savings because the service could be valid.

title: Visit type consistency
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. If the bill explicitly identifies an inpatient or outpatient visit, flag a code whose fictional reference specifies the other setting. Unknown settings are not mismatches. Request documentation and assign no assumed savings.

title: Avoid overlapping disputed amounts
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. Several findings may describe the same line. For each line use the largest supported disputed amount, capped at its billed amount, then sum across lines. Do not add duplicate, unbundling, and price differences for the same line. These illustrative potential reductions are not guaranteed refunds and are not necessarily patient savings.

title: Requesting an itemized billing review
text: SYNTHETIC DEMO GUIDANCE. Identify the account, service dates, procedure codes, line IDs, and questioned amounts. Ask the billing office for an itemized explanation, supporting service records, review of possible duplicate or bundled charges, and a corrected statement if appropriate. Use polite conditional language. Do not assert fraud or cite fictional policies as real law, insurance coverage, or contractual obligations.
